reason: Centrality alone does not give all central elements or independence. The proof coordinates a rank-one RTT residue construction, a nontrivial leading-filtration cancellation and a maximal-current-degree invariant argument to obtain complete free generation. These remain concrete H2 obligations beyond the previously counted PBW theorem.
core_assessment: The rank-one Q relation yields Z, the three-leg RTT calculation proves centrality, and the formal derivative expansion gives leading symbol(1-r)sum Y_ii^(r-1)(-1)^i. The maximal current degree of an invariant is then eliminated using center-freeness of the scalar quotient and PBW, proving all graded central generators and filtered lifting.
